C0491.split_decision: False merge by the title-parser. Neither thread is about the clone 'Rod's Favorite' itself — both threads are about HYBRID CROSSES that use Rod's Favorite as a seed parent. Thread 4694: 'S. leucophylla var. alba Rod's Favorite × alata dark Stone Co, MS' (an areolata cross). Thread 5233: 'S. leucophylla var. alba Rod's Favorite × minor var. okefenokeensis giant' (an excellens cross). The threads document seedling batches, not named clones. In thread 5233 post #6 (2024-09-04) Mike notes 'the two clones that I selected out from this batch are quite special' — those two selections may warrant clone pages once Mike names them. No wiki entry written. The actual Rod's Favorite parent clone has no source thread of its own in this archive (a search for it as a clone-clusters candidate would need to look outside meizzwang's started threads).
C0491.notes: Open question for Mike: (a) Should each hybrid-batch thread get a 'breeding line' wiki page? (b) Have the 2 selected seedlings from thread 5233 been named, and should they get clone pages? (c) Is there source material for the Rod's Favorite parent clone elsewhere?
